# Definition 
**Menopause** is the cessation of menses for $\geq$ 12 months. 

# Presentation 
Pale vaginal mucosa, hot flashes 

# Diagnosis 
Diagnosis is clinical **unless** prior history of abnormal menses.

In the latter case, diagnose with **elevated FSH**.

# Management 
## Symptoms 
- Hot flashes: combined estrogen+progestin therapy
	- if no uterus (s/p hysterectomy) and no BCa family history: estrogen therapy
